actions.text: Received in the Senate. Read twice. Placed on Senate Legislative Calendar under General Orders. Calendar No. 427.
Motion to reconsider laid on the table Agreed to without objection.
On motion to suspend the rules and pass the bill, as amended Agreed to by the Yeas and Nays: (2/3 required): 374 - 49 (Roll no. 196).
Passed/agreed to in House: On motion to suspend the rules and pass the bill, as amended Agreed to by the Yeas and Nays: (2/3 required): 374 - 49 (Roll no. 196).
Considered as unfinished business. (consideration: CR H3810-3811)

At the conclusion of debate, the Yeas and Nays were demanded and ordered. Pursuant to the provisions of clause 8, rule XX, the Chair announced that further proceedings on the motion would be postponed.
DEBATE - The House proceeded with forty minutes of debate on H.R. 2860.
Considered under suspension of the rules. (consideration: CR H3769-3771; text: CR H3769-3770)
Mr. Westerman moved to suspend the rules and pass the bill, as amended.

dimensions.assessment: Affects residents, county marine resources committees, tribal governments, and local communities within the Northwest Straits region of Washington state.
dimensions.evidence: marine waters of the Strait of Juan de Fuca and of Puget Sound from the Canadian border to the south end of Snohomish County

dimensions.assessment: Continues existing regional advisory, restoration recommendation, and community-based conservation activities.
dimensions.evidence: protect and restore the marine waters, habitats, and species of the Northwest Straits region to achieve ecosystem health and sustainable resource use

dimensions.assessment: The source material does not state specific appropriations or funding levels for the reauthorization.
Amends existing statutory provisions for the advisory commission and committee structures, but explicitly denies regulatory authority.
dimensions.evidence: Nothing in this title provides the Commission with authority to issue regulations or implement any Federal law or regulation.

dimensions.assessment: Extends the program for a fixed duration of seven years.
dimensions.evidence: The authority to carry out this title shall terminate on the date that is 7 years after the date of the enactment

missing_information: Specific funding amounts or appropriation authorizations
Exact number of individuals directly employed or compensated
importance_detail.rationale: Reauthorizes the Northwest Straits Marine Conservation Initiative and its advisory commission for seven years, continuing regional marine protection, data collection, and local committee support in specified waters of Washington state.
